parsed.name: Coherent Sapphire 激光器
parsed.description: 这是一台 Coherent Sapphire 系列激光器，用于提供稳定的连续激光输出。此类激光器常用于显微成像、荧光激发、光路校准和其他需要稳定光源的实验场景，并支持功率开关与输出功率调节。
parsed.description_en: This is a Coherent Sapphire series laser that provides stable continuous laser output. Such lasers are commonly used for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, and other laboratory applications requiring a stable light source, with support for laser on/off control and power adjustment.
